questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Pangong Tso?
questions.e: Pangong Tso (Ladakh) is number 3. High-altitude saline lake on the Line of Actual Control. The others: 1 is Barren Island; 2 is Jog Falls; 4 is Renuka Lake.

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Indira Point?
questions.e: Indira Point (Andaman & Nicobar) is number 4. Southernmost point of India, on Great Nicobar. The others: 1 is Dhuandhar Falls; 2 is Sambhar Lake; 3 is Renuka Lake.

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Deepor Beel?
questions.e: Deepor Beel (Assam) is number 4. Ramsar wetland on Guwahati's edge. The others: 1 is Kandla (Deendayal Port); 2 is Pench National Park; 3 is Jim Corbett National Park.

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve?
questions.e: Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve (Maharashtra) is number 1. Maharashtra's oldest national park, near Chandrapur. The others: 2 is Barren Island; 3 is Kandla (Deendayal Port); 4 is Sundarbans National Park.

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Chilika Lake?
questions.e: Chilika Lake (Odisha) is number 3. Asia's largest brackish-water lagoon; Irrawaddy dolphins; India's first Ramsar site (1981) with Keoladeo. The others: 1 is Idukki Dam; 2 is Prayagraj (Sangam); 4 is Palamau Tiger Reserve.

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Kanha National Park?
questions.e: Kanha National Park (Madhya Pradesh) is number 4. Barasingha (hard-ground swamp deer) brought back from the brink. The others: 1 is Dudhwa National Park; 2 is Keoladeo National Park; 3 is V.O. Chidambaranar Port (Tuticorin).

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Mormugao Port?
questions.e: Mormugao Port (Goa) is number 3. Iron-ore export port. The others: 1 is Gulf of Mannar Biosphere Reserve; 2 is Valmiki Tiger Reserve; 4 is Indira Point.

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Nanda Devi?
questions.e: Nanda Devi (Uttarakhand) is number 3. Highest peak entirely within India's Himalaya; World Heritage park. The others: 1 is Lonar Lake; 2 is Mettur Dam; 4 is Chilika Lake.

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Kalinga (Dhauli)?
questions.e: Kalinga (Dhauli) (Odisha) is number 1. Ashokan rock edicts near Bhubaneswar, site linked to the Kalinga war. The others: 2 is Anamudi; 3 is Khardung La; 4 is Prayagraj (Sangam).

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Doddabetta?
questions.e: Doddabetta (Tamil Nadu) is number 3. Highest point of the Nilgiri Hills. The others: 1 is Indravati National Park; 2 is Dal Lake; 4 is Gir National Park.

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Bandipur National Park?
questions.e: Bandipur National Park (Karnataka) is number 1. Part of the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve with Mudumalai and Nagarhole. The others: 2 is Haldia; 3 is Great Himalayan National Park; 4 is Manas National Park.

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Bhakra Nangal Dam?
questions.e: Bhakra Nangal Dam (Himachal Pradesh / Punjab) is number 2. On the Sutlej; Gobind Sagar reservoir. The others: 1 is Barren Island; 3 is Haldia; 4 is Anamudi.

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Dholavira?
questions.e: Dholavira (Gujarat) is number 3. Harappan city on Khadir island in the Rann of Kutch; World Heritage Site. The others: 1 is Kaziranga National Park; 2 is Nagarhole National Park; 4 is Sardar Sarovar Dam.

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Sadiya: Brahmaputra confluence?
questions.e: Sadiya: Brahmaputra confluence (Assam) is number 4. Near Sadiya the Dibang and Lohit join the Siang to form the Brahmaputra. The others: 1 is Harike Wetland; 2 is Marine National Park, Gulf of Kutch; 3 is Kuno National Park.

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Haldia?
questions.e: Haldia (West Bengal) is number 4. Dock complex of the Kolkata port on the Hooghly. The others: 1 is Mundra Port; 2 is Tso Moriri; 3 is Zoji La.

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Simlipal National Park?
questions.e: Simlipal National Park (Odisha) is number 2. Melanistic (black) tigers; Biosphere Reserve in Mayurbhanj. The others: 1 is Nathu La; 3 is Sriharikota; 4 is Nagarjunsagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve.

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Khajuraho?
questions.e: Khajuraho (Madhya Pradesh) is number 2. Chandela temples; World Heritage Site. The others: 1 is Keibul Lamjao National Park; 3 is Dhanushkodi; 4 is Mormugao Port.

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Lonar Lake?
questions.e: Lonar Lake (Maharashtra) is number 1. Crater lake formed by a meteorite impact in basalt; saline and alkaline. The others: 2 is Chilika Lake; 3 is Manas National Park; 4 is Rakhigarhi.

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Dudhwa National Park?
questions.e: Dudhwa National Park (Uttar Pradesh) is number 4. Swamp deer on the Nepal border; terai grasslands. The others: 1 is Bandipur National Park; 2 is Visakhapatnam Port; 3 is Bhoj Wetland.

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Keibul Lamjao National Park?
questions.e: Keibul Lamjao National Park (Manipur) is number 3. The only floating national park; sangai (brow-antlered deer). The others: 1 is New Mangalore Port; 2 is Sasthamkotta Lake; 4 is Manas National Park.

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Kanyakumari?
questions.e: Kanyakumari (Tamil Nadu) is number 2. Southern tip of the mainland, where three water bodies meet. The others: 1 is Saramati; 3 is Ranthambore National Park; 4 is Tso Moriri.

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Bhoj Wetland?
questions.e: Bhoj Wetland (Madhya Pradesh) is number 2. Upper and Lower lakes of Bhopal; Ramsar site. The others: 1 is Prayagraj (Sangam); 3 is Sasthamkotta Lake; 4 is Khardung La.

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Kangchenjunga?
questions.e: Kangchenjunga (Sikkim) is number 4. Highest peak in India; third-highest in the world. The others: 1 is Great Himalayan National Park; 2 is Wular Lake; 3 is Kalinga (Dhauli).

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Sundarbans National Park?
questions.e: Sundarbans National Park (West Bengal) is number 3. Mangrove tigers in the Ganga–Brahmaputra delta; World Heritage Site. The others: 1 is Keibul Lamjao National Park; 2 is Kolleru Lake; 4 is Harike Wetland.

questions.q: Four places are marked 1 to 4 on the map. Which number marks Shipki La?
questions.e: Shipki La (Himachal Pradesh) is number 3. Sutlej enters India here from Tibet; trade route. The others: 1 is Kolleru Lake; 2 is New Mangalore Port; 4 is Kangchenjunga.
